name: roll shoulder blade reach lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shoulder blade. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your shoulder blade.
Place the roller under the shoulder blade and let your body weight settle onto it.
Reach your top arm forward and back as you roll.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
